title: DEMO KILLS PAY AS CAREER KILLS
why: His answer of 2026-10-12: gameplay must be exactly the same in DEMO and CAREER, loot stays as it is now, and ammo is shared. A DEMO kill gave half a magazine back and every third kill gave a Bandage, which never happens in CAREER, so ammo and heals worked differently in the two modes. A DEMO kill now scores its points and nothing else; ammo and heals come from the world as they do in CAREER.
now: A kill in DEMO no longer gives ammo back or a free Bandage, the same as in CAREER.
